name: Foxtail Barley
desc: Foxtail Barley (Hordeum jubatum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hordeum jubatum, with common names foxtail barley, bobtail barley, squirreltail barley, and intermediate barley, is a perennial plant species in the grass family Poaceae.
